page.overview:
What is Glow Stick?

Glow sticks are chemistry-related items, which can be lit up in the player's hand for a limited time.

While equipped, players can glow sticks to shake them, causing them to appear bright regardless of the light level. This is only an aesthetic change, as no light is emitted to the surrounding area. A particle effect is visible until the durability runs out. The glow stick's durability depletes while lit, in both Survival and Creative modes.

See Bedrock Edition level format/Item format.

Category:Non-renewable resources Category:Education Edition items
